It ain't that it ain't workin'. We're doin' damage! We beat 'em that time, didn't we!

strings.jp:
{0b:08}【 盗賊風の男 】{0b:09}
勝てたって言ってもよ、
たった4人の凶戦士に
2百人も殺されたんだぜ・・・{1a}それにあの時互角に戦えたのは
バルデスの旦那と先生だけだ。{1a}オイゲンの旦那ぁ、あんたにゃ悪いが
やっぱりオレ達だけじゃ
とてもじゃねえが敵わねえよ。{0c:fe}

strings.en:
{0b:08}【 Thief-Looking Man 】{0b:09}
Beat 'em, ya say, but just four
Berserkers killed two hundred of us...{1a}And the only ones who could fight 'em
even that time were Mister Valdes and
the sensei.{1a}Mister Eugen, no offense to ya, but
there's no way we can take 'em by
ourselves.{0c:fe}
strings.tl: Beat 'em, ya say, but just four Berserkers killed two hundred of us... // And the only ones who could fight 'em even that time were Mister Valdes and the sensei. // Mister Eugen, no offense to ya, but there's no way we can take 'em by ourselves.
Quit your whinin'. They're just like beasts. The ones that lose their nerve go first, one by one...

strings.en:
{0c:2b5423520b0c}{1c:13}{0b:08}【 Eugen 】{0b:09}
Here they come!!{0c:fe}

{1c:17}{0b:08}【 Fatum the Undying 】{0b:09}
Not yet...{0c:fe}

{0c:3aff2b521000527840}{1c:17}{0b:08}【 Fatum the Undying 】{0b:09}
Why do you stop me!?{0c:2b5009fe}

strings.tl: That's right! Why don't ya finish it!? // I pity 'em, but once they've gone like that, killin' 'em's the only way left! // Besides, there's still four Berserkers left!
We might be onto a way to tear those swords off! Trust Qumran and wait!!
Wait? Meanwhile the bodies are sure to pile up. // And you know it as well as I do. Taking a Berserker alive is far harder than killing one.

strings.en:
{1c:17}{0b:08}【 Fatum the Undying 】{0b:09}
...Do as you please. I will find other prey.{0c:fe}
strings.tl: ...Do as you please. I will find other prey.

strings.jp:
{1c:13}バルデス、お前の気持ちも分かるが
今度ばかりは奴の言う通りだ。
凶戦士の動きを封じることなど
いかにお前でも不可能だ。{0c:2b5209fe}
strings.read:
{1c:13}バルデス、お前の気持ちも分かるが
今度ばかりは奴の言う通りだ。
凶戦士の動きを封じることなど
いかにお前でも不可能だ。{0c:2b5209fe}
strings.tl: Valdes, I know how ya feel, but this time he's right. Pinnin' down a Berserker's impossible, even for you.

{0c:3aff521216}{1c:14}{0b:08}【 Valdes 】{0b:09}

{1c:16}This'll stop 'em movin'!!{0c:2b5009fe}
